gaps.sentence: The painting is believed ___ (steal) by an organised gang.
gaps.explanation: The theft preceded the believing: is believed to have been + stolen.

gaps.sentence: The match ___ (abandon) because of the storm, so we got a refund.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive with have to: had to be + past participle for past obligation.

gaps.sentence: The letters ___ by the time I arrived at the office.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: the sending preceded the arrival.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript might ___ if you keep touching it with bare hands.
gaps.explanation: Get + past participle (get damaged) is an informal passive common with mishaps.

gaps.sentence: The road ___ (resurface) at the time, so we took the coast route instead.
gaps.hint: in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: 'At the time' requires past continuous passive: was being + resurfaced.

gaps.sentence: Too much time ___ (waste) on pointless meetings these days.
gaps.explanation: 'These days' signals a present general situation: is + wasted (singular 'time').

gaps.sentence: The message ___ have been misheard by the interpreter.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive = modal + have been + past participle: must have been misheard.

gaps.sentence: A final decision ___ (MAKE) once the consultation ends.
gaps.explanation: The decision does not make itself: future passive will be made.
